what: item-hash: under `hir::persist::relocating`, `impl Persist for Body` (crates/hir-def/src/expr_store/persist.rs) still writes dense ids raw: the `block_scopes` column (u64 BlockId bits), the `macro_calls` column (u64 MacroCallId bits), the hygiene half of `ident_hygiene` and `type_hygiene` (`IdPair.b` = raw SyntaxContext::into_u32), and the BlockId words `Expr::Block` keeps in the HIR extra words (hir/columns.rs `block_words`). Relocate each through the table (Kind::Block, Kind::MacroCall, Kind::Context) when a relocation scope is open, as the codec docs promise, so the bytes are the same in every database. Until then `hir_def::item_hash::portable_body` refuses any body with a block, macro call or non-root path hygiene (the identity is Err), so this is what makes those bodies cacheable. No change wanted when no scope is open.
